case_number: 2024 INSC 522; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2395 OF 2023 (S.L.P. (CRL.) NO. 6687 OF 2023)
summary: Application for discharge under section 227 Cr.PC concerning custodial death; prosecution materials examined; appellant alleged to be informant in robbery case and involved in taking deceased to police station; high court dismissed section 482 application; supreme court examines scope of record under section 227 Cr.PC; discharge denied due to prima facie evidence of involvement in custodial death.
final_judgment: Discharge application rejected; order of high court and trial court upheld.
